svg.title: Ankora v0.2 External Benchmarks vs. DockM8 v1.1.1 and AMDockVS v0.14.1 (ADR-031)
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of recorded ADR-031 two-axis external benchmarks (Records 143, 144, and 146) comparing Ankora v0.2, DockM8 v1.1.1, and AMDockVS v0.14.1 across three holo LIT-PCBA targets (N=780), induced-fit FlexRes on apo PPARG 1PRG (N=180), shared PoseBusters 0.6.5 and chemical integrity audits, and offline deployment footprint versus raw rigid throughput trade-offs.
svg.text: ADR-031 TWO-AXIS EXTERNAL BENCHMARKS / RECORDS 143 · 144 · 146 / 2,000 PAIRED BOOTSTRAP REPLICATES
Ankora v0.2 vs. DockM8 v1.1.1 & AMDockVS v0.14.1
Higher is better · Axis A (shared inputs) & Axis B (native end-to-end pipelines)
†CNN_VS extracted from GNINA extra JSON (default rank-1 is minimizedAffinity). 0/3 targets external_preferred.
Cross-Docking Pose Recovery & Full Apo Screening (N = 180)
Gatekeeper rotamers A:MET364, A:ARG288, A:HIS266 · Coupled E8 PoseBusters 0.6.5
APO 1PRG AXIS B SCREENING (N = 180, BEDROC20 — HIGHER IS BETTER)
AMDockVS GPU FlexRes blocked (Uni-Dock >1 torsion; GNINA no --flex; AD-GPU OpenCL). Axis A Ankora Core 0.287 ★ vs both.
PANEL C · CHEMICAL INTEGRITY & SHARED POSEBUSTERS 0.6.5
Audited under identical PoseBusters 0.6.5 (dock config) with docked-water parity
AMDockVS GNINA OpenBabel export dropped formal +1 charges on protonated amines; Ankora preserves Meeko topology.
PANEL D · OFFLINE DEPLOYMENT & THROUGHPUT TRADE-OFF
Zero-Conda Footprint vs. Raw Rigid Screening Speed
Measured on-disk footprints and WSL2 RTX 5050 wall-clock timings
HONEST TRADE-OFF: WHERE AMDOCKVS v0.14.1 LEADS (RAW RIGID SPEED)
• 300-SMILES prep: 7.1–7.9 s (AMDockVS batch) vs. ~1–2 min (Ankora isolated audit)
• 300-lig rigid GPU: 26.9–41.9 s (Uni-Dock CUDA) vs. ~2–3 min (AD-GPU CUDA)
Choose Ankora for: 1-click offline install · GPU FlexRes · metal/valence rigor · verifiable Export v5/v6
Ankora v0.2 post-benchmark installers stay within ADR-031 ≤ 1.00 MiB delta (Win +815 KiB, .deb +397 KiB; Record 145).
